metadata.description: DevBench orchestrate marketplace -- ships the devbench-orchestrate plugin (autonomous execution phase) with quota wait-and-resume on by default, done-integrity guards, and operator-mode amendment support. The companion devbench-authoring marketplace (backlog-assistant included) lives at plugin-authoring/ in the same repo (issue #224).

plugins.name: devbench-orchestrate
plugins.description: Autonomous backlog execution with LLM-as-judge review, guarded hooks, and the orchestrate skill. Includes quota wait-and-resume on by default, done-integrity guards, and operator-mode amendment. Use during the execution phase.
